description: v2.2.9 (pre-release, re-cut #3 - supersedes re-cut #2). Re-cut #2 shipped a patch-time crash in 'Bypass native integrity checks' on device (PatchException Collection is empty): the injected invoke-static had six source registers, exceeding the five-register limit of the regular opcode form; it now uses invoke-static/range, mirroring the original wrapper. Everything else from re-cut #2 unchanged - All open issues resolution (#22 AMOLED framework-only attributes + Google Photos fix, #21 Amazon native feed video autoplay patch, #5 Mereframe JVM try/catch bypass + Spoof install source superclass-chain walk). 137 patch entries / 174 appearances. No device verification yet. Latest full release remains v2.2.4; v2.2.8 unchanged.
